Ch 17 (or another odd # of your choosing), hold your place, ch5 more, dc into the 17th chain that you’re holding (or whatever odd # you chose), ch1, skip a chain and dc into the 2nd stitch, ch1, skip a chain and dc into the second stitch. Continue till the end. Ch1 and turn, dc into the first stitch. Ch1, skip the space & dc into the next stitch. Ch1, skip the space & dc into the next stitch. Continue till the end. Repeat this row until desired length.   #crochetscarf #crochetheadband #crochettutorial #crochet #freecrochetpattern
